name: UAL 219 颠簸 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 219, from New York to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11,000 meters over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 219，从纽约飞往武汉，正保持 11,000 米飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 2000 meters, OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，正保持 2,000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 9200 米，因穿越冲突航空器，通过 9800 米前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9200 米，通过 9800 米前加快下降，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 9,200 meters, you are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, inform ATC this situation and request further descent to 8,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 9,200 米，正在遭遇中度晴空颠簸，向空中交通管制报告情况并请求进一步下降至 8,400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 9200 meters, we are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, request further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，正保持 9,200 米，我们正在遭遇中度晴空颠簸，请求进一步下降至 8,400 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，向武汉管制确认是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动航空器，请确认是否为冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, negative, the aircraft is a military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，不行，该航空器是一架军用航空器，正与你当前航迹平行飞行，并将很快超越你，脱离相关航空器后报告。

cards.audioText: B: Now that aircraft has passed you, report it to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在该机已超过你，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, clear of traffic.

cards.audioText: UAL 219, reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计执行 ZF-03 进场，使用 Runway 36。
cards.referenceText: reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计执行 ZF-03 进场，使用 Runway 36，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: you are now leveling at 4,200 meters and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在 4,200 米改平并接近 ZF，已收到 A 情报，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 219, approaching ZF, maintaining 4200 meters, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 219，接近 ZF，正保持 4,200 米，A 情报。

cards.audioText: Now you have established ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, established ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: All stations, all stations, be advised Runway 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, break, UAL 219, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有电台，所有电台，请注意，因一架故障航空器占用跑道，Runway 36R 已关闭。暂停，暂停，UAL 219，飞航向 360，爬升至并保持 1,500 米。
cards.referenceText: roger flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞航向 360，爬升至并保持 1500 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR-DME approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR-DME 进近 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR, DME approach Runway 04, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR、DME 进近 Runway 04，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are inbound course for Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 向台航道上，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，跑道 04 向台。
